actions.description: Home all axes with GRBL $H and wait for the controller to report Idle. Homing is motion; this binding does not send the upstream EndstopMonitor's Channel 4 poll. The catalogue cap.motion.home.v1 is not used: its numeric speed_scale has no equivalent in the native $H command.

outputs.description: True when a fresh status query after $H reports Idle; GRBL has no separate homed flag
outputs.name: homed

outputs.description: Axes the native $H homes: x, y and z together
outputs.name: axes

outputs.description: GRBL state of the status line the result came from
outputs.name: state

actions.description: Clear a GRBL alarm lock with $X (the upstream unlock), then read one fresh status. This is the declared re-enable after a safety reset; it does not resume a feed hold and it does not home the machine.
actions.name: unlock

outputs.description: True after the $X write; GRBL sends no acknowledgement for $X
outputs.name: unlocked

outputs.description: GRBL state of the first status query after $X
outputs.name: state

actions.description: Stop all motion on the resource with a declared deceleration profile and report the stopping position. This capability is always cancellable=false and is exempt from rate limiting.

inputs.description: Optional class field; the GRBL feed-hold byte carries no deceleration value, so the controller's own deceleration profile applies and this value is not applied
inputs.name: deceleration

actions.name: stop_motion

facts.text: CNC is the GRBL CNC wrapper; its constructor takes port, baud and log_source and leaves the serial object unset
connect opens serial.Serial on port and baud, waits, resets the input buffer, writes CRLF and resets again
parse_status parses a GRBL status line into state, an MPos tuple of three floats, the raw Pn field and the subset of X, Y and Z pins
get_status writes '?' and returns the first parsed status line before its 2 s deadline
read_settings writes '$$' and collects $N=value lines until 'ok' or its 10 s deadline
home writes '$H' and returns without waiting for the homing cycle
feed_hold writes the single GRBL feed-hold byte '!' and returns without waiting for motion to stop
unlock writes '$X' and sleeps 0.2 s; it has no acknowledgement read
move_absolute builds G90 G1 with the supplied X, Y and Z words and an F feed word
move_relative builds G91 G1 with the supplied X, Y and Z deltas and an F feed word
wait_for_idle polls get_status and returns only when the state is exactly Idle
_write raises CNCError when no serial object is open
The independent safety endstop is oscilloscope Channel 4; below 1.0 V is triggered, 1.0 to 4.5 V is a fault and 4.5 V or more is clear
STOP means feed hold has been sent if possible, the workflow ends and the operator must inspect and explicitly restart
GRBL Pn:P is ignored for safety; real limit flags are X, Y and Z, including the X/Y/Z part of Pn:PX, Pn:PY and Pn:PZ
Channel 4 must be monitored continuously during motion and a trigger must issue feed hold immediately
On a trigger the operator must stop and report; automatic back-off, jog, retry or continued scanning is forbidden
The clone says to stay inside the known travel envelope and that a hard limit alarm is not a safety strategy, but states no travel number
The clone recommends feed-rate ranges by operation but states no single device feed bound
All motion workflows must create an EndstopMonitor before motion starts and stop it after motion has ended; if the monitor enters STOP, the app exits without more motion
CNC's public methods are connect, close, unlock, home, feed_hold, get_status, read_settings, wait_for_idle, move_absolute and move_relative; the class has no cycle-start or resume method
